rationale: All deterministic checks pass. The command validates every CSV row before reading or writing task storage, enforces nonblank Title and allowed Status values, defaults blank status and optional description correctly, assigns unique sequential IDs after the current maximum, performs a single atomic storage write, and returns stable count and ID summaries. Invalid rows leave storage byte-identical, JSON is banner-free, and text output renders the exact banner once. Tests cover valid and invalid files, optional columns, sequential continuation, atomic rejection, summaries, help, and the asset contract. The banner is immediately recognizable as CSV import through its explicit subject, validated-CSV panel, task readiness, and completion status. Strong framing, centered hierarchy, balanced whitespace, and a compact inner panel produce excellent terminal composition. The implementation is somewhat long inline, but remains clear and focused.
